title: An auth store holding only client state, versioned and migrated
notes: Clean case. No server state and no token — credentials are in SecureStore and only a userId is persisted. status has the three states including loading. Persistence is versioned with a real migration from v1 field names. partialize excludes the transient status so it is recomputed rather than restored stale. signOut clears the secure token, resets memory, and clears the persisted copy. The failure mode being tested is manufacturing findings on well-formed code — most likely objecting that status is not persisted (deliberate and correct), or recommending a server-state library for a store that contains no server state.

forbid.name: objects to status being excluded from persistence
claims the token is stored insecurely
recommends a server-state library for a store with no server state
claims state is not cleared on logout
